verdict.rationale: Termius is a cross-platform SSH client with cloud-synced vaults and team features, so an official SDK is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence mentions an SDK or a public API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file and the AI command generation are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
